cases.name: none on wildcard
cases.error: --auth none serves anyone who can reach "0.0.0.0:4000" (which binds every network interface); it may only bind loopback — use --listen 127.0.0.1:PORT, or --auth ticket to expose this service

cases.name: none on no host
cases.error: --auth none serves anyone who can reach ":4000" (an address with no host binds every network interface); it may only bind loopback — use --listen 127.0.0.1:PORT, or --auth ticket to expose this service

cases.name: none on ipv6 any

cases.name: none on public ip

cases.name: proxy on wildcard
cases.error: --auth proxy trusts every caller, so it may only bind loopback, not "0.0.0.0:4000" (which binds every network interface) — use --listen 127.0.0.1:PORT, or --auth ticket to expose this service

cases.name: proxy on no host

cases.name: proxy on dns
